fluff.overview: Conventional infantry within the FWLM serve as the backbone of provincial defense across a patchwork of semi-autonomous states, each maintaining its own military traditions and equipment preferences. Tracked mechanized platoons sacrifice road speed for all-terrain capability, carrying their infantry across ground that would halt wheeled vehicles. The FWLM assigns these formations to worlds where rough terrain or poor infrastructure demands mobility that wheels cannot provide. Carrying infantry-portable long-range missile systems, these platoons provide indirect fire capability that extends their engagement envelope well beyond personal weapons range, though the weight and bulk of the launchers reduce the platoon's mobility.
